name: The Sun Risen
flavour: The Sun at its height. Nothing moves you; you move everything.
art_prompt: a huge riveted iron gauntlet fist punching down and cracking the ground

B.note: B · tilted card (detail: the least: flat colours, one symbol, nothing else)

recipe.subject: One single fortune-teller tarot card standing upright and tilted about 12 degrees clockwise, filling the picture from top to bottom, seen straight on. The card has a thick gilded gold border with rounded corners, small ornate gold corner pieces and a thin dark line just inside it and a deep brown-black face. One huge bold symbol fills almost the whole face: a huge blazing orange sun disc with a stern frowning face wearing a small gold crown, its rays long sharp spikes twice as long, in orange, gold and black. The symbol is so big it overlaps the border a little. Nothing else on the card: no stars, no landscape, no corner ornaments, no frame lines inside
